inspection_method: normalized awesome-list URL to repository root, shallow git clone, then inspected README, CONTRIBUTING, root Markdown sheets, Astro config, package scripts, source libraries, tests, and public redirect/header files

anchors.why: Frames Devhints as a large TLDR-style developer documentation cheatsheet collection.
Documents runtime requirements, local preview, frontmatter fields, redirects, localization, tests, and publishing notes.
Stores many short topic pages as individual Markdown files.
Provides page loading/query logic for turning many Markdown files into a searchable site.
Builds a client-searchable projection over page content.
Defines Astro build behavior, markdown/rendering choices, tests, formatting, and build scripts.

known_limits: Cheatsheet brevity is useful for lookup but not sufficient for VAKS evidence review.
Search index and related-post ranking are activation aids, not authority.
The awesome-list URL included a tree/hash fragment and required normalization before cloning.
